title: Lego Made 10 Billion Minifigures—More Than Humanity
hook: Lego made 10 billion minifigures, more than the human population.
closing: A tiny toy now outnumbers humanity, and hundreds of millions more arrive yearly.
question: How many Lego figures live with you?

segments.say: Lego made 10 billion minifigures, enough to outnumber every person alive.
Lego minifigures reached 8.3 billion, showing the toy had already grown to a planet-sized population.
Lego makes 400 million minifigures yearly, so the plastic population keeps expanding faster than humanity.
